assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including the vague text (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md lines 43-45 contain the parsed 'Environment / Version' section with content 'Not sure which version -- using whatever is deployed on staging.' Line 59 also explicitly notes: 'The Environment / Version section contains only vague text with no extractable version identifier.'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution determines that no version identifier can be extracted from the vague description (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md section 4.5.2 (lines 9-25) analyzes the Environment / Version text, scans for explicit version numbers, product-prefixed versions, and version keywords, finds none in each category, and concludes: 'No version pattern can be extracted. Skipping to sub-step 4.5.6 (gap flagging).'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution outputs the gap comment: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md section 4.5.6 (lines 40-51) outputs the gap comment. The ADF representation on line 66 contains the exact text with em dash: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' The plain-text rendering on line 47 uses double hyphens but the ADF (the actual Jira comment payload) matches the asserted text exactly.

assertion_results.text: The gap comment includes the Comment Footnote (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md lines 49-51 show the gap comment ending with a horizontal rule followed by the footnote: 'This comment was AI-generated by sdlc-workflow/triage-bug v0.13.10.' The ADF representation (lines 69-96) also includes this footnote as a separate paragraph with a link to the plugin repository.
